pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Modern Steinitz Defense
pages.notes: Siesta 7.O-O: overview called it a gambit (material is level) and plan 1 claimed an open f-file attack with ...g5; plan 3 routed Nd2-f1-g3 with no knight on d2 and the rook on f1; plan 4 flagged ...f5 (already played). Rewritten around 7...Bd3 8.Re1 and Bc2. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Modern Steinitz Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 proposed ...Bb7 with the bishop already on d7. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Modern Steinitz Defense
pages.notes: Rubinstein 6...Nge7: plan 1 had an impossible a4-b4 pawn route; plan 2 had ...Nge7-g6 with the knight already on e7; overview said the knight development is delayed. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, 5.c3 Bd7 6.d4
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted a "c3-knight" (c3 is a pawn); plan 2 suggested an untypical ...d5 break. Rewritten. Reviewer rejected wording that called ...Nge7 a fianchetto; fixed and re-accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, 5.c3 Bd7 6.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...exd4 with no pawn on d4; plan 2 said ...Na5 challenges a bishop on a4 it does not attack. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, Rubinstein, 7.Bb3
pages.notes: 7.Bb3: plan 1 had Nf3-d2-f1-g3 (the queen's knight goes, not the f3-knight); plan 3 had ...O-O with the f8-bishop at home and Ng5 as a Black move. Overview now explains the Ng5 threat against f7 and 7...h6. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, Bronstein Variation
pages.notes: Bronstein: plan 1 had an impossible a4-b4 route; plan 2 had a ...c5 break blocked by the c6-knight. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, Bronstein, 7.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed d2-f1 with the rook on f1; plan 4 moved the c6-knight to c7 or b8 (impossible). Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, Bronstein, 7.O-O Bg7 8.dxe5 Nxe5
pages.notes: Overview said knights were exchanged on e5 (Black has recaptured with the knight); plan 1 had Rd1 through the queen and an a4-b4 route; plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2-f1-g3. Reviewer rejected a vague d-file plan; replaced with Nxe5 dxe5 Bxd7+ and the queen trade, re-accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Modern Steinitz, Bronstein, 7.O-O Bg7 8.Re1
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted the f3-knight via d2-f1-g3 (the queen's knight goes); plan 3 had ...Na5 without ...b5. Fixed. British spelling.
